title: VRCAvatarOptimizer Config
description: Configuration schema for dev.bluscream.avataroptimizer_vrc. Defines shader mapping rules and per-platform/rank avatar performance limits. Fetched at runtime from GitHub with local file fallback.

$schema.description: Path or URL to the JSON Schema document.

version.description: Semantic version of this config file (e.g. '1.0.1'). Used for cache invalidation and change tracking.

shaderMapping.description: Rules that map PC/unknown shaders to VRChat Mobile-compatible Quest shaders.

rules.description: Ordered list of shader mapping rules. Rules are sorted by 'priority' ascending after load (lower = evaluated first). First matching rule wins.

platformProfiles.description: Performance profiles per target platform (Android, iOS, PC). Each platform has base limits and per-rank overrides.

ShaderMappingRule.title: ShaderMappingRule
ShaderMappingRule.description: A single rule that maps a source shader name (or material property set) to a Quest-compatible target shader.

priority.description: Evaluation order. Lower values are checked first. Defaults to 100 when omitted. Use steps of 10 to leave room for insertion.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this rule matches, why it was added, and which materials/commits it relates to.

matchType.description: How 'pattern' is compared against the original shader name.

pattern.description: The shader name pattern to match. Interpretation depends on 'matchType'. Can be empty string when matching via 'requiredProperties' only.

targetShader.description: Unity shader path to switch to when this rule matches (e.g. 'VRChat/Mobile/Toon Standard').

caseSensitive.description: Whether 'pattern' matching is case-sensitive. Defaults to false.

requiredProperties.description: If non-empty, the material must expose ALL listed shader property names (via Material.HasProperty) for this rule to match. Useful for detecting locked/obfuscated shaders by their properties rather than their name.

PlatformProfile.title: PlatformProfile
PlatformProfile.description: Performance limits for a target platform. 'limits' defines the platform-wide baseline; each rank's 'limits' overrides fields on top of it.

limits.description: Base limits that apply to ALL ranks on this platform. Rank-specific limits override individual fields. Fields absent here default to unlimited.

ranks.description: Per-rank limit overrides. Fields present here override the platform base limits; absent fields inherit from the platform base.

RankProfile.title: RankProfile
RankProfile.description: Performance limits for a specific VRChat avatar performance rank within a platform.

limits.description: Limit overrides for this specific rank. Fields not set here inherit from the platform base 'limits'.

ProfileLimitData.title: ProfileLimitData
ProfileLimitData.description: A complete set of VRChat avatar performance limits. All fields are optional; missing fields are treated as unlimited (int.MaxValue / no restriction).

MaxTriangles.description: Maximum total polygon/triangle count across all meshes on the avatar.

MaxMeshRenderers.description: Maximum number of static MeshRenderer components.

MaxMaterialSlots.description: Maximum total number of material slots across all renderers.

MaxBones.description: Maximum number of bones (Transform nodes weighted in skinned meshes).

MaxAnimators.description: Maximum number of Animator components (excluding the root animator).

MaxTextureMemoryBytes.description: Maximum total VRAM usage for all textures in bytes. Common values: 10485760 (10 MB), 41943040 (40 MB), 157286400 (150 MB).

MaxAssetBundleSizeBytes.description: Maximum compressed .vrca AssetBundle size in bytes. Read live from VRC.ValidationHelpers.GetAssetBundleSizeLimit when available.

MaxPhysBoneTransforms.description: Maximum number of transforms (bones) affected by VRCPhysBone components in total.

MaxPhysBoneCollisionChecks.description: Maximum number of PhysBone collision check operations per frame (physbone x collider pairs).

MaxContacts.description: Maximum number of VRCContactReceiver + VRCContactSender components combined.

MaxActiveParticles.description: Maximum number of simultaneously active particles across all systems.

MaxMeshParticlePolyCount.description: Maximum total polygon count for mesh-based particle systems.

ParticleTrailsEnabledAllowed.description: Whether particle trail emission is allowed. Set false for mobile platforms.

ParticleCollisionEnabledAllowed.description: Whether particle collision is allowed. Set false for mobile platforms.

MaxRaycasts.description: Maximum number of VRChat Raycast components / operations.

MaxConstraints.description: Maximum number of VRChat constraint components (VRCConstraint). Unity built-in constraints are not Quest-allowed and are removed via ComponentBlacklist.

MaxConstraintDepth.description: Maximum chain depth of chained VRChat constraints.

MaxClothVertices.description: Maximum total number of cloth-simulated vertices across all Cloth components.

MaxPhysicsColliders.description: Maximum number of physics Collider components (Box/Sphere/Capsule/Mesh).

MaxAudioSources.description: Maximum number of AudioSource / VRCSpatialAudioSource components.

ComponentBlacklist.description: Component type names that are forcibly stripped from the avatar during optimization. Names are matched case-insensitively against Component.GetType().Name. Platform-level and rank-level blacklists are unioned together.

ComponentWhitelist.description: If non-empty, ONLY these component type names are kept; everything else is removed. Rank-level whitelist takes precedence over platform-level.
